Q1: Sulfamic acid presents known (Tier 1) organ and systemic hazards, alongside expanded (Tier 2) dermal/eye and environmental hazards. Q3: Sulfamic acid is extensively characterized, with 12,000 literature references and a well-defined small molecule structure.
